topic: Reviewing reported system issues and fixes
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing potential bugs or discrepancies in data reporting, specifically those allegedly raised by a colleague. It was discussed whether these reported issues needed to be formally fixed or documented.

[me] advised that the goal should not be accommodating every client request but rather maintaining proper processes. [p1] suggested logging observed anomalies into Jira.

[me] provided a link to an inventory asset within the sandbox analytics environment for review.
decisions: The reported issues/discrepancies were discussed and reviewed.
